opening.text: I'm a 24-year-old woman of Southeast Asian background. I've been dealing with some skin issues for the past two months. I have blisters on my skin, some small and some large, and they're itchy. I also have a rash on my cheeks. Inside my mouth, I have raw sores on my cheeks, the roof of my mouth, and my lips. I've also been losing hair.
